stem: A physical plant is in Room B, but the electronic record still shows Room A and no move event is recorded. What should Technician II do first?
choices: Enter a guessed move time so the record matches the room
Confirm physical identity and reconstruct the last known-good state and movement evidence before requesting or making an authorized correction
Move the plant back to Room A without documenting it
rationale: Traceability corrections must be evidence based. Technician II should establish physical identity, last known-good state, and movement history rather than inventing a transaction.
